project_type: Java 21 Spring Boot 3.3.5 modular monolith — Insurance Integration Middleware and Cross-Account AWS Document Transfer Platform
test_framework: JUnit 5 + Mockito + Spring Boot Test + Testcontainers (PostgreSQL container for integration tests)
verification_instructions: 1. Run mvn compile — must succeed with zero errors. 2. Run mvn test — all tests must pass. 3. If DB is available: mvn spring-boot:run and check /actuator/health + /swagger-ui.html
setup_instructions: PostgreSQL must be running on localhost:5432 with database 'insurance_integration', user 'postgres', password 'postgres'. For tests, Testcontainers spins up its own PostgreSQL container automatically.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell environment. No live AWS credentials required — LocalStack profile available. Tests use Testcontainers so Docker must be available for integration tests.
contribution_requirements: No new Maven dependencies unless absolutely required. Must use only existing pom.xml dependencies. Run mvn compile after each module — fix ALL errors before next module.
key_patterns: Package root: com.insurance.integration. Subpackages per domain: partner, insurer, ingestion, schema, validation, document, storage, transfer, notification, audit, common, config, security. Each domain has entity/, repository/, service/, controller/, dto/ subpackages. Use @Data/@Builder/@NoArgsConstructor/@AllArgsConstructor from Lombok. Use ApiResponse<T> for success, ApiError for errors. UUID PKs with gen_random_uuid() in DB. BaseEntity needed for common fields. JpaConfig has @EnableJpaAuditing. SecurityConfig uses stateless JWT — no sessions. PasswordEncoder bean is BCrypt(12). V1 creates partners+insurers, V2 creates partner_insurer_mappings+api_clients. Migrations follow V3-V10 plan in docs/06-Database-Design.md.
directory_structure: src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/ — main source root. Each domain module (partner, insurer, ingestion, schema, validation, document, storage, transfer, notification, audit) has subdirectories: entity/, repository/, service/, controller/, dto/. config/ holds SecurityConfig, JpaConfig, SwaggerConfig. security/ holds filter/, service/, dto/. common/ holds enums/, exception/, response/, logging/, utility/. src/main/resources/db/migration/ holds Flyway SQL files. src/test/ mirrors main structure with unit/ and integration/ subdirs. infrastructure/ holds aws/, docker/, lambda/, localstack/.
